framework.name: Daybreak 出場框架 v3
framework.unit: 以「100% ＝ 本週期打算賣出的全部持倉」計，不涉及任何人的實際持倉
framework.unit_en: Measured as "100% = everything you plan to sell this cycle"; no one's actual holdings are involved

hedge.rule: 收盤連 5 日在 200 日均線之下 → 減 20%；連 5 日收回或 MVRV Z 7 日均 < 0.5 → 補回
hedge.rule_en: Close below the 200-day MA for 5 straight days → cut 20%; buy back after 5 straight closes above it, or when the MVRV Z 7-day average < 0.5

onchain.rule: MVRV ÷ 前一輪高點連 5 日 ≥ 0.75 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: MVRV ÷ prior-cycle peak ≥ 0.75 for 5 straight days → sell one step

onchain.rule: 連 5 日 ≥ 0.80 → 再賣一階
onchain.rule_en: ≥ 0.80 for 5 straight days → sell one more step

onchain.rule: 前兩條觸發過後，每次收盤創新高但 MVRV ≤ 一年最高的 0.9 倍 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: After both have fired: each new closing high with MVRV ≤ 0.9× its 1-year high → sell one step

framework.top3: MVRV Z／NUPL／Puell 四年百分位任兩項 ≥ 80 標為頂部區，只作讀值、不連動賣出。原本的加速規則（≥ 85 多賣兩階、≥ 90 全部賣完）在過去四輪都於週期中段先觸發，2026-11-05 取消
framework.top3_en: Any two of the MVRV Z / NUPL / Puell 4-year percentiles at ≥ 80 marks the top zone; a reading only, with no selling attached. The old acceleration rule (≥ 85 sell two extra steps, ≥ 90 sell everything) fired mid-cycle first in all four past cycles and was dropped on 2026-11-05
framework.time_stop: 2029/10–2030/03 剩餘部位每月等量賣完
framework.time_stop_en: 2029/10–2030/03: sell the remainder in equal monthly amounts

title.zh: 短期持有者 SOPR 跌破 1（轉為賠錢賣）
title.en: STH-SOPR fell below 1 (selling at a loss)

decomp.zh: 拆解：和 7 天前比，實現獲利 −17.70%、實現虧損 +22.20%，主要是認賠變多
decomp.en: breakdown: versus 7 days ago, realized profit −17.70%, realized loss +22.20%; mainly more loss selling

means.zh: 短期持有者整體轉為賠錢賣：短期持有者開始認賠，短線轉弱；在上漲趨勢中，1 常是回檔的支撐。
means.en: Short-term holders started selling at a loss: short-term holders are capitulating and the short term weakens; in uptrends, 1 often acts as pullback support.

rule.zh: 和上一期（前一天的資料）比，這個狀態翻過來了。每天只比較前後兩期，所以只有翻轉當天會出現，之後幾天標「第 N 天」。
rule.en: Compared with the previous edition (the prior day's data), this state flipped. Only consecutive editions are compared, so it fires on the day of the flip and then counts days.

means.zh: 礦工收入相對一年平均偏低：礦工收入受壓，弱勢礦工可能被迫賣幣或關機，歷來低檔接近底部。
means.en: Miner revenue is low versus its 1-year average: miners are squeezed and weak ones may sell or shut down; lows have historically been near bottoms.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在跌得最多的 2%（第 1.7 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest drops of the past year (percentile 1.7).

title.zh: 佐證燈號「MVRV 對一年均值」熄滅

fig.zh: 條件：MVRV 高於自己的一年均值；現值 1.404
fig.en: condition: MVRV 高於自己的一年均值; now 1.404

means.zh: 這盞佐證燈熄滅：這項條件不再支持目前的市場階段。佐證燈只顯示，不參與階段判定。
means.en: This supporting light turned off: the condition no longer supports the current market stage. Supporting lights are shown only and do not decide the stage.

rule.zh: 和上一期（前一天的資料）比，這個狀態翻過來了。每天只比較前後兩期，所以只有翻轉當天會出現，之後幾天標「第 N 天」。
rule.en: Compared with the previous edition (the prior day's data), this state flipped. Only consecutive editions are compared, so it fires on the day of the flip and then counts days.

title.zh: 價格貼近短期持有者成本（−0.19%）
title.en: Price near the short-term holder cost basis (−0.19%)

means.zh: 價格貼近短期持有者成本：短期持有者在這裡回到成本，跌破就轉為虧損；這條線在上漲中常是支撐、下跌中常是壓力。
means.en: Price is near the short-term holder cost: short-term holders break even here and fall into a loss below it; the line often supports rallies and caps declines.

rule.zh: 收盤離這條線不到 3%（現在 -0.19%）。
rule.en: The close is within 3% of this line (now -0.19%).

title.zh: 價格貼近短期持有者最厚的籌碼（−1.63%）
title.en: Price near the thickest short-term holder pile (−1.63%)

means.zh: 價格貼近短期持有者籌碼最厚的地方：很多人在這裡買進，價格回到這裡時常出現解套賣壓，站穩之後則會轉為支撐。
means.en: Price is near the thickest pile of short-term holder coins: many bought here, so price often meets break-even selling, which turns into support once it holds.

rule.zh: 收盤離短期持有者最厚的那一格不到 3%。
rule.en: The close is within 3% of the thickest short-term holder band.

title.zh: 價格貼近真實市場均價（−2.36%）
title.en: Price near the true market mean (−2.36%)

means.zh: 價格貼近真實市場均價：活躍投資人的平均成本、歷來的多空分界，附近容易拉鋸。
means.en: Price is near the true market mean: the average cost of active investors and a long-standing bull/bear line; price often chops around it.

rule.zh: 收盤離這條線不到 3%（現在 -2.36%）。
rule.en: The close is within 3% of this line (now -2.36%).

title.zh: 持有者行為：5 項同時異動

fig.zh: 非流動供給 7 日急升、短期持有者 SOPR 跌破 1（轉為賠錢賣）、價格貼近短期持有者成本（−0.19%）、價格貼近真實市場均價（−2.36%）
fig.en: Illiquid supply: sharp 7-day rise; STH-SOPR fell below 1 (selling at a loss); Price near the short-term holder cost basis (−0.19%); Price near the true market mean (−2.36%)

means.zh: 同一類的好幾項同時異動：單一指標可能是雜訊，同類多項一起動比較值得注意；各項的意思看各自的說明。
means.en: Several signals of the same kind fired together: one indicator alone can be noise, several moving at once deserve more attention; see each one for its meaning.

rule.zh: 同一類有 3 項以上同時異動（這次 5 項）。
rule.en: Three or more signals of the same kind at once (5 this time).

title.zh: 穩定幣供給 7 日急降

means.zh: 穩定幣供給快速減少：資金從加密市場撤出（贖回成美元），可以用來買幣的子彈變少。
means.en: Stablecoin supply is shrinking fast: money is leaving crypto (redeemed for dollars), leaving less dry powder to buy with.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在跌得最多的 2%（第 0.0 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest drops of the past year (percentile 0.0).

title.zh: 非流動供給 7 日急升

means.zh: 長期不動的幣變多：幣被收進不常交易的錢包，市場上可流通的籌碼變少，偏累積。
means.en: Illiquid supply is rising: coins are moving into wallets that rarely trade, shrinking the tradable float; leans toward accumulation.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在漲得最多的 2%（第 100.0 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest rises of the past year (percentile 100.0).
